% Long URLs where a line may end inside them. In the PDF, url.sty breaks a
% URL after a character of \UrlBreaks or \UrlBigBreaks, such as a slash or
% a period, and never adds a hyphen. The web page does not break a URL
% right after its scheme's //. hyperref's \nolinkurl, as biblatex
% prints a DOI, and url.sty's \path break the same way. A link whose text
% is prose breaks only at its spaces.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\title{Long URLs}
\author{A. Author\\ \nolinkurl{a_author@example.org}}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
A long address in the middle of a sentence, such as
\url{https://example.org/internationalization/documentation/representations/characterizations},
moves to the next line whole on the web unless it may break inside.
At the end of a sentence, the period stays with the address
\url{https://example.org/reports/understandingrepresentationsofcharacterization/introduction}.
A query has more break points:
\url{https://example.org/search?query=representations&page=2&sort=relevance#results}.
A footnote has one too.\footnote{See
\url{https://example.org/internationalization/documentation/representations/characterizations}.}

A DOI printed as biblatex prints it:
\href{https://doi.org/10.1000/representations.characterizations.2000.123456}{\nolinkurl{10.1000/representations.characterizations.2000.123456}},
and a path: \path{/usr/local/share/internationalization/documentation/representations/}.
A link whose text is prose, \href{https://example.org/internationalization/documentation}{the documentation of the representations and their characterizations}, breaks at its spaces only.
See also \cite{guide}.

\nolinkurl{10.1000/representations.characterizations.2000.123456} begins this paragraph, and a relative path, \path{../src/internationalization/documentation}, may break after its two dots.
\begin{thebibliography}{9}
\bibitem{guide} A.~Author. A guide to the documentation.
\url{https://example.org/internationalization/documentation/representations/characterizations}.
\end{thebibliography}
\end{document}
